issue.title: Rust BlockReason emits the blocked-reason mark key for bob plan and the Mac Capture agenda, with a shared JSON BM vector fixture

task_type_fields.proposal: Teach bob-cli's Rust Blocked-reason derivation (the BlockReason used by `bob plan` and the Bob Mac Capture idle agenda / `capture-pomodoros --tasks`) to emit the same display mark key that bob-ledger-tools' api.blockMarks v1 computes for a Blocked [?] #task row: dep, prj, p1-p4, repeat, date, stale, or none (neutral). Use the precedence and digit rules in docs/blocked-marks.md (own_first: own open prerequisite > project blocked > own future date; within date holds recurring > ladder priority > hand; unresolved ids stay neutral). Move the BM conformance vectors from the docs/blocked-marks.md table into a shared JSON vector fixture in bob-cli that both the Rust tests and the bob-plugins scripts/test-ledger-tools-block-marks.cjs suite read, so the two engines cannot drift. Then let `bob plan` Blocked rows and the Mac Capture agenda show the same mark glyph/family as Obsidian.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-ft (Blocked-reason marks) explicitly scoped Rust/`bob plan`/Mac Capture adoption out ("Out of scope" in plan 202611/blocked_reason_marks.md, design-lead adjustment 5: a JSON fixture becomes worthwhile only when Rust adopts the mark key) and asked its visual_review phase to record this as a follow-up. It spans bob-cli Rust, bob-mac-capture, and bob-plugins tests, so it needs its own plan.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-ft.8 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2) as the plan-mandated follow-up of the Blocked-reason marks epic, which kept Rust adoption out of scope.
